l-m-h3-b0c33-01.s.s1.r.d: U-0 uhlala engu-0 noma ngabe uyishintsha ngamaphesenti amangaki, ngakho lesi sibonelo sifanelana nesimangalo.

l-m-h3-b0c34-04.s.s1.r.d: Inzalo elula ingu-50 × 10,000 won futhi eyokuxubana ingu-62.9 × 10,000 won cishe, ngakho eyokuxubana ikhulu.

l-m-h3-b0c37-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma amaphutha ehlangene endaweni eyodwa, isilinganiso samanani aphelele siba sincane noma i-MSE ifana ngenxa yokwenza isikwele, ngakho isisho siyaphuka.

l-m-h3-b0c40-01.title: Ingabe inani le-Fahrenheit njalo likhulu kuno-Celsius?
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi ukuguqula izinga lokushisa liye ku-Fahrenheit kwenza inombolo ibe likhulu siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese ukhomba futhi uchaza icala lapho kungenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.material: I-Fahrenheit itholakala ngokuphindaphinda i-Celsius ngo-1.8 bese kungezwa u-32 (F = 1.8C + 32). Isimangalo: inombolo yezinga lokushisa elifanayo ku-Fahrenheit njalo ikhulu kuno-Celsius.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha izinga lokushisa lapho isimangalo siphuka khona.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s1.explain: −50°C ingu-1.8×(−50)+32=−58°F. −58 mncane kuno-−50, ngakho isimangalo sokuthi inombolo ye-Fahrenheit inkulu siyaphuka.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuguqula u-−50°C kuya ku-Fahrenheit kunikeza u-−58°F, futhi u-−58 mncane kuno-−50, ngakho isimangalo siyaphuka.
l-m-h3-b0c40-01.s.s2.model.1: Ngenombolo engu-negative, ukuphindaphinda ngo-1.8 kuyenza ibe incane, ngakho nangemva kokungeza u-32 iba ngu-−58. Inombolo ye-Fahrenheit incane, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h3-b0c41-01.title: Uma 1m=100cm, ingabe 1m²=100cm²?
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isisho esithi "njengoba 1m=100cm, 1m²=100cm²" siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza isimo lapho kungenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.material: Isisho: Njengoba 1m=100cm, 1m²=100cm². Endaweni lapho indawo yomhlabathi iguqulwa isuka ku-m² iye ku-cm², ake sihlole ukuthi lesi sisho siyiqiniso yini.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha iqiniso elikhombisa ukuthi lesi sisho siyiphutha.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukuguqulwa kobude kuyiso. Akuyona ubufakazi bokuthi indawo iyiphutha.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.b: Lokho kuyiqiniso, kodwa akukhombisi ukuthi liyini inani eliguquliwe.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.r.d: Kubale ku-m² kuphela, ngakho akukwazanga ukuqhathanisa no-cm².
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s1.explain: Uma uhlangothi olulodwa lungu-100cm, indawo ingu-100×100=10000cm². Kufanele wenze isikwele sesilinganiso sokuguqula ubude.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s2.model.0: 1m² ungu-100cm×100cm=10000cm², kodwa isisho sithe u-100cm², ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h3-b0c41-01.s.s2.model.1: Indawo ithola ngokuphindaphinda ububanzi nokuphakama, ngakho isilinganiso sokuguqula nesona senziwa isikwele, okwenza kube u-10000cm².

l-m-h3-b0c45-02.material: Ezinombolweni zikaFibonacci 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …, inombolo enkulu ÷ inombolo encane yezinombolo ezimbili eziseduze iba seduze ne-golden ratio, cishe engu-1.618. Isitatimende: lesi silinganiso njalo siphakeme kuno-1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s1.r.a: 2 iphakeme kuno-1.618, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s1.r.c: 1.625 iphakeme kuno-1.618, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s1.r.d: 1.667 iphakeme kuno-1.618, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s1.explain: 8÷5=1.6 iphansi kuno-1.618. Lesi silinganiso siba seduze ngokuya ngenhla nangaphansi kuka-1.618 ngokushintshana.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s2.model.0: 8÷5=1.6, futhi 1.6 iphansi kuno-1.618, ngakho isitatimende esithi "njalo siphakeme" siyaphuka.
l-m-h3-b0c45-02.s.s2.model.1: Isilinganiso sishintshana ngenhla nangaphansi kuka-1.618, ngakho noma inani elilodwa elincane njenge-1.6 liyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s1.r.a: Ama-engeli engeza ku-180°, okuncane kuno-360°, ngakho kwenza isiqongo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s1.r.b: Ama-engeli engeza ku-240°, okuncane kuno-360°, ngakho kwenza isiqongo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s1.r.c: Ama-engeli engeza ku-300°, okuncane kuno-360°, ngakho kwenza isiqongo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s1.explain: Ngo-6, 60°×6=360°, ngakho kuba yindiza eyisicaba. Ukwenza isiqongo, isamba sama-engeli kumele sibe ngaphansi kuka-360°.
l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma uqoqa abangu-6, ama-engeli engeza ku-360°, ngakho alala ethe nca futhi akwenzi isiqongo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-01.s.s2.model.1: Ngo-3, 4, noma 5 isamba sincane kuno-360° futhi ayaphakama, kodwa ngo-6 isamba singu-360°, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-28.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo sokuthi ∫fg dx = ∫f dx · ∫g dx siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese ukhomba futhi uchaza icala lapho kungeyona iqiniso (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.material: Isimangalo: Esikhawini [0,1], ∫f(x)g(x)dx = (∫f(x)dx)(∫g(x)dx) njalo iyabamba. Thola u-f no-g lapho lesi simangalo singalungile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.a: Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-1, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.b: Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-1/2, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s1.r.c: Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-0, ngakho kuyisibonelo esivumelana nesimangalo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s2.model.0: Uma f=g=x, khona ∫x²dx=1/3, kodwa umphumela wamanani e-∫x dx ungu-1/4, ngakho amanani amabili ayahluka futhi kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-28.s.s2.model.1: I-integral yomphumela ingu-1/3, futhi ukuphindaphinda ama-integral ahlukene kunikeza u-1/4, ngakho isimangalo siyaphuka ku-f=g=x.

l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.r.c: (1+1/n²)ⁿ nayo iba seduze no-1. Lesi yisibonelo esivumelana nesitatimende.

l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s1.explain: (1+1/n)ⁿ ingu-2.717 cishe lapho n=1000 futhi iyi-converge ku-e. Akusiyo u-1.
l-m-h3-b0d08-01.s.s2.model.0: Noma isisekelo se-(1+1/n)ⁿ siya ku-1, i-exponent n ikhula ngesikhathi esifanayo, ngakho iyi-converge ku-e≈2.718, okungeyona u-1, ngakho-ke kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h3-b0d08-23.material: Isitatimende: sin x ≤ x kuyiqiniso kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela x (ngama-radian). Thola u-x lapho lesi sitatimende siphutha khona.
l-m-h3-b0d08-23.s.s1.r.a: sin 3≈0.14 ingu-3 ubude obuphezulu, ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0d08-23.s.s1.r.b: sin 0.5≈0.48 ingu-0.5 ubude obuphezulu, ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.

l-m-h3-b0d08-23.s.s1.explain: sin(−2)≈−0.91 inkulu kune-−2. sin x≤x iyiqiniso kuphela ku-x≥0.

l-m-h3-b0d08-27.title: Ifomula ye-∫xⁿdx iyahluleka kuma-n athini?
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.goal: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende ∫xⁿdx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze isimo lapho siphutha khona (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.material: Isitatimende: Kuyo yonke inombolo ephelele n, ∫xⁿdx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C (x>0) iyiqiniso. Thola u-n lapho lesi sitatimende siphuka khona.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s1.r.a: x¹/1=x i-antiderivative ka-1, ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s1.r.b: −1/x i-antiderivative ka-1/x², ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s1.r.c: x³/3 i-antiderivative ka-x², ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanela isitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s1.explain: Uma n=−1, isihlukanisi n+1 ngu-0. ∫(1/x)dx=ln x+C, okuyinkulumo ehlukile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s2.model.0: Uma n=−1, n+1=0 yenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, ngakho ifomula ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa, futhi i-antiderivative ka-1/x ngu-ln x+C.
l-m-h3-b0d08-27.s.s2.model.1: Ukuthola okuphuma ku-x⁰ akunikezi 1/x, ngakho awukwazi ukuthola 1/x ngefomu ngu-xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1), okwenza n=−1 ibe yisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-h3-b0d09-15.title: Uma ama-dot product elingana, ingabe ama-vector amabili alingana?
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.goal: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende sokuthi a·b=a·c kusho b=c siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze isimo lapho siphuza (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.material: Isitatimende: kuvektha a engeyona i-zero vector, uma a·b = a·c khona-ke b = c. Ku-a = (1, 0), thola u-b no-c abakhombisa ukuthi lesi sitatimende siyiphutha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.a: a·b=3 no-a·c=2 ahlukile, ngakho isisekelo asinelisiwe.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.c: b no-c bayi-vector efanayo, ngakho abakwazi ukuphula isitatimende.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.r.d: a·b=1 no-a·c=2, ngakho ama-dot product awalingani.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s1.explain: Uma a=(1,0), a·b iyingxenye ye-x ka-b. Uma izingxenye ze-x zilingana futhi izingxenye ze-y ziyahlukana, ama-dot product ayalingana kodwa b≠c.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s2.model.0: a·b=3 no-a·c=3, ngakho ama-dot product ayalingana, kodwa izingxenye ze-y ze-b no-c ziyahlukana, ngakho b≠c. Lesi yisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-15.s.s2.model.1: a=(1,0) ibheka kuphela ingxenye ye-x, ngakho noma ukhetha b no-c abanezingxenye ze-y ezihlukene, ama-dot product afana.

l-m-h3-b0c38-10.title: Sidinga ini ukuthola ithuba elinemibandela?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.goal: Cabanga ukuthi iyiphi indinganiso (ulwazi) edingeka ngempela ukuthola ithuba elinemibandela lomcimbi u-A wenzeka uma u-B wenzeke, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uyikhethile.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.material: Sakha isihlungi se-spam. Sifuna ukuthola ithuba u-P(A|B) lokuthi i-imeyili ingu-spam (A) uma iqukethe igama 'free' (B). Ake sicabange ukuthi yimaphi amathuba amabili adingeka ngempela.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.prompt: Yiwaphi amanani amabili adingeka ngempela ukuthola u-P(A|B)?
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.a: Ngalawa amabili kuphela, u-P(A|B) akanqunyiwe. Udinga ukuhlangana.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.r.b: Lawa amabili asetshenziselwa ukuthola u-P(B|A). Isethenjwa sibheke ngenye indlela.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). Iyingxenye, phakathi kwamacala lapho u-B wenzeka khona, lapho u-A naye wenzeka khona.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.0: Isebenzisa kuphela amacala lapho u-B wenzeka njengesethenjwa, ngakho isihlukanisi ngu-P(B) futhi inombolo engaphezulu idinga u-P(A∩B), ithuba lokuthi zombili zenzeke ndawonye.
l-m-h3-b0c38-10.s.s2.model.1: Ngo-P(A) no-P(B) kuphela, awazi ukuthi zombili zenzeka kangakanani ndawonye, ngakho akunqunyiwe, futhi ukuhlangana kuyadingeka.

l-m-h3-b0c44-08.material: Idayisi elifanele liphonswa izikhathi eziningana, futhi u-X yinani lezikhathi u-6 uvela ngazo. Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olubalulekile ukuthola u-P(X=2) usebenzisa ukusabalalisa kwe-binomial u-B(n, p) elandelwa ngu-X.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.o.a: Inani lokuphonswa u-n nethuba u-p lokuthola u-6 ekuphonseni kokukodwa
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.b: Umbala wedayisi awunamsebenzi nethuba lokuthola u-6.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.c: Ukuzama ngakunye kuzimele, ngakho imiphumela yangaphambilini ayishintshi ithuba.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.r.d: Ngedayisi elifanele, ithuba liyafana noma liphonswa kanzima kangakanani.
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s1.explain: Ukusabalalisa kwe-binomial kunqunywa inani lokuzama u-n nethuba u-p lempumelelo ekuzameni kokukodwa. Ngala manani amabili ungathola u-P(X=2).
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s2.model.0: Ukusabalalisa kwe-binomial kunqunywa u-n no-p, ngakho udinga ukwazi inani lokuphonswa nethuba elingu-1/6 lokuthola u-6 ukuthola u-P(X=2).
l-m-h3-b0c44-08.s.s2.model.1: Umbala wedayisi nemiphumela yangaphambilini akushintshi ithuba, ngakho u-n no-p kuphela adingekile.

l-m-h3-b0c46-06.material: Wenza unxantathu phansi ngentambo eyindingilizi enezikhala ezilinganayo ezingu-12 ezimakwe ngamafindo, ukwenza i-engeli elungile. Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi unxantathu owenzile uyunxantathu one-engeli elungile yini.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.b: Inani eliphelele lezikhala kudingilizi lwentambo, elingu-12
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.r.b: Noma ngezikhala ezingu-12, ungathola unxantathu ongelona onxantathu one-engeli elungile, njengezikhala ezingu-5, 5, no-2.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi uhlangothi ngalunye kwezintathu lunezikhala ezingaki
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.o.d: Indawo yomhlaba lapho wenziwa khona unxantathu
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.r.d: Noma umhlaba mkhulu, awukwazi ukwazi isimo sikanxantathu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s1.explain: Uma izinhlangothi ezintathu zingu-3, 4, no-5 zezikhala, khona-ke 3²+4²=5², ngakho yi-engeli elungile. Isamba esiphelele sezikhala ezingu-12 sodwa asinqumi isimo.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s2.model.0: Udinga ukwazi inani lezikhala zezinhlangothi ezintathu ukuhlola ukuthi isamba sezikwele siyasebenza yini, ngakho udinga inani lezikhala zohlangothi ngalunye.
l-m-h3-b0c46-06.s.s2.model.1: Noma isamba siyizikhala ezingu-12, kokubili 3, 4, 5 no-5, 5, 2 kungenzeka, ngakho isamba sodwa asikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi yi-engeli elungile yini.

l-m-h3-b0c46-07.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiliphi izinga (ulwazi) elidingeka ngempela ukuthola ukuthi isampula lenhlolovo limele wonke umuntu yini, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani ulikhethile.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.material: Inhlolovo yathumela amaphepha emibuzo ezigidini zabantu abakhethwe ohlwini olwalithambekele ohlangothini olulodwa, kodwa umphumela wawuhluke kakhulu ekuhleni. Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi isampula limele wonke umuntu yini.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.r.a: Inani lemibuzo alikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi isampula limele yini.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.o.b: Kuphela ukuthi inani labaphendulile likhulu yini
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.r.b: Noma inani likhulu, ukukhetha uhlobo olulodwa kuphela lwabantu kwenza umphumela uchemeke.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.r.d: Usuku alunaso isixhumana kangako nokuthi isampula limele yini.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s1.explain: Uma indlela yokukhetha ithambekele ohlangothini olulodwa, noma isampula likhulu kangakanani, alimeli wonke umuntu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s2.model.0: Noma isampula likhulu liyachema uma kukhethwe abantu abathile kuphela, ngakho indlela ekhethwe ngayo ibaluleke kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-07.s.s2.model.1: Inani elikhulu lodwa alinikezi isiqinisekiso sokuthi isampula limele, ngakho kufanele uhlole ukuthi likhethwe ngokulinganayo ngokungahleliwe yini.

l-m-h3-b0c46-08.title: Udinga ukwazi ini ukuxazulula i-Caesar cipher?
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiliphi izinga (ulwazi) elidingeka ngempela ukuthola umbhalo wangempela womlayezo we-Caesar cipher, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani ulikhethile.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.material: I-Caesar cipher ishintsha i-alfabhethi ngokuhambisa uhlamvu ngalunye ngenani elithile lezindawo. Umuntu owathola umlayezo ofihliwe ufuna ukuthola umbhalo wangempela.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.a: Usayizi wephepha elibhalwe kulo umlayezo ofihliwe
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.a: Usayizi wephepha awunaso isixhumana nomthetho osetshenziswe ukushintsha izinhlamvu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.b: Inani lezinhlamvu lodwa alikwazi ukutshela ukuthi lihanjiswe ngezindawo ezingaki.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi lihanjiswe ngezindawo ezingaki nangasiphi isiqondiso
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.o.d: Isikhathi lapho kuthunyelwe khona umlayezo ofihliwe
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.r.d: Isikhathi sokuthunyelwa asinaso isixhumana nomthetho osetshenziswe ukushintsha izinhlamvu.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s1.explain: Uma wazi inani lezindawo nesiqondiso lahanjiswa ngaso, ungalihambisela emuva ngenye indlela ukuthola izinhlamvu zangempela.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s2.model.0: Uhlamvu ngalunye lwahanjiswa ngenani elithile lezindawo, ngakho uma wazi inani lezindawo nesiqondiso, ungahambisa emuva ukuthola umbhalo wangempela.
l-m-h3-b0c46-08.s.s2.model.1: Isikhathi, usayizi wephepha, nenani lezinhlamvu akusona isimiso sokushintsha, ngakho akudingeki ukuze kuxazululwe.

l-m-h3-b0c47-06.material: Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi iphethini yendabuko inokulingana kokujikeleza yini. Ukulingana kokujikeleza yisici lapho iphethini uma ijikelezwa nxazonke zephoyinti nge-engeli encane kuno-360°, ilingana ncamashi nokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ngempela ukwazi ukuthi inokulingana kokujikeleza yini?
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.r.a: Ubude bomphetho obodwa abukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi iyalingana yini uma ijikelezwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.r.b: Inkathi eyenziwe kuyo ayinaxhumana nokuthi iyalingana yini uma ijikelezwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.r.c: Inani lemibala alikutsheli ukuthi iyalingana yini uma ijikelezwa.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi iyalingana yini uma ijikelezwa nxazonke zesikhungo esikhethiwe
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s1.explain: Ukulingana kokujikeleza kusho ukuthi uma ukhetha isikhungo futhi ujikeleze nge-engeli ethile, ilingana nokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s2.model.0: Ukulingana kokujikeleza yisici sokulingana nokuqala uma ijikelezwa, ngakho udinga ukukhetha isikhungo ne-engeli, ujikeleze, bese ubona ukuthi iyalingana yini.
l-m-h3-b0c47-06.s.s2.model.1: Umbala, umjikelezo, nenkathi akunaxhumana nomphumela wokujikeleza, ngakho udinga kuphela ukuhlola ukuthi iyalingana yini uma ijikelezwa.

l-m-h3-b0c47-07.material: Uhlelo ngalunye lwezinombolo lusebenzisa izimpawu nezindlela ezihlukile. Izinombolo zamaRoma akuyona uhlelo lwenani lendawo, kuyilapho uhlelo lwase-Babylon olunesisekelo-60 nohlelo lwanamuhla olunesisekelo-10 kuyizinhlelo zenani lendawo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.prompt: Yisiphi isilinganiso sokunquma ukuthi iyihlelo lenani lendawo yini?

l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.a: Isiqondiso sokubhala asinaxhumana nokuthi inani linqunywa kanjani.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.o.b: Ukuthi uphawu olufanayo lunenani elihlukile ngokuya ngendawo yalo yini
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.c: Izinombolo zase-Babylon zinezimpawu ezimbalwa kakhulu futhi isahlelo senani lendawo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.r.d: Isimo noma imvelaphi yezimpawu akuyona isilinganiso.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s1.explain: Ukuthi uphawu olufanayo lunenani elihlukile ngokuya ngendawo elikuyo kuyisihluthulelo sohlelo lwenani lendawo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s2.model.0: Kusisekelo 10, u-2 ungu-2 endaweni yamayunithi no-20 endaweni yamashumi, ngakho ukuthi inani lishintsha ngendawo yilona isilinganiso.
l-m-h3-b0c47-07.s.s2.model.1: Uhlelo lungaba yihlelo lenani lendawo noma ngabe inani lezimpawu noma isiqondiso sokubhala kuhlukile, ngakho kumele ubheke ukuthi inani lishintsha kanjani ngendawo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.b: Uma r=1 luhlangana ku-1, futhi lesi silinganiso sodwa sasizophutha lokho.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.c: r=2 uyipositive kodwa uyahlukana, futhi r=−0.5 unegethivu kodwa uyahlangana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.r.d: r=1/2 akayona inombolo ephelele kodwa uyahlangana ku-0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s1.explain: Uma −1<r<1 luhlangana ku-0, uma r=1 luhlangana ku-1, futhi uma r≤−1 noma r>1 luyahlukana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.0: Uma r=1 uchungechunge nalo luhlangana ku-1, kuyilapho ku-r≤−1 noma r>1 luyahlukana, ngakho udinga ukwazi ukuthi −1<r≤1 yini.
l-m-h3-b0d07-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma ubheka kuphela |r|<1, uphutha r=1, ngakho kumele uhlole ukuthi −1<r≤1 yini ukuze unqume ngokunembile ukuthi uchungechunge luyahlangana yini.

l-m-h3-b0d07-12.material: Yini enquma ukuthi uchungechunge lwe-geometric olungapheli a+ar+ar²+… (a≠0) luyahlangana yini?
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi igama lokuqala a lincane kuno-1 yini
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.a: Uma a=0.5 no-r=1, amagama ahlala ku-0.5, ngakho luyahlukana.

l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.r.b: Noma a eyipositive, luyahlukana uma r=2, futhi noma unegethivu, luyahlangana uma r=1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi inani eliphelele lesilinganiso esivamile u-r lincane kuno-1 yini
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s1.explain: Uma a≠0, uchungechunge lwe-geometric luyahlangana uma |r|<1 futhi isamba salo singu-a/(1−r). Uma |r|≥1, luyahlukana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.0: Ukuze amagama aye ku-0, |r|<1 iyadingeka, futhi khona-ke izamba ezithile zisondela ku-a/(1−r), ngakho usayizi wesilinganiso esivamile wuyena isilinganiso.
l-m-h3-b0d07-12.s.s2.model.1: Ukushintsha u-a akushintshi ukuthi i-converge yini, ngakho u-a akuyona indlela yokulinganisa. Ukuthi inani eliphelele luka-r lingaphansi kuka-1 yini kunquma i-convergence.

l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi uphawu luka-f'(x) lushintsha yini nhlangothi zombili luka-a

l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s2.model.0: Noma f'(a)=0, akuyona i-extremum uma izimpawu zezinhlangothi zombili zifana, ngakho kumele wazi ukuthi uphawu luyashintsha yini.
l-m-h3-b0d07-14.s.s2.model.1: Iyi-extremum kuphela uma kushintsha kusuka ekukhuleni kuya ekwehleni, noma kusuka ekwehleni kuya ekukhuleni, ngakho ushintsho lophawu luka-f' nhlangothi zombili luyadingeka.

l-m-h3-b0d07-30.goal: Thola ukuthi yimuphi umbandela (ucezu lolwazi) odingeka ngempela ukuthola isimo se-integral lapho ukufaka esikhundleni kusebenza khona, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uyikhethile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.material: Sifuna ukuhlukanisa ukuthi i-integral ifanele yini ukuhlanganiswa ngokufaka esikhundleni. Kufanele sibheke ini ku-integrand?

l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi ingxenye eyodwa inesimo sokuphuma kwenye ingxenye yini
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.b: Kunamacala amaningi lapho ufaka esikhundleni ngisho noma kungeyona ifrakshini.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.c: Ezinye ama-integral, njengo-x·eˣ, ayimiphumela kodwa ayikwazi ukwenziwa ngokufaka esikhundleni.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.r.d: Nakuba kunomsebenzi we-trigonometric, ama-integral amaningi awadingi ukufaka esikhundleni.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s1.explain: Uma inesimo ∫g(f(x))f'(x)dx, ungamisa u=f(x) bese uyiguqula ibe ∫g(u)du.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s2.model.0: Uma ingxenye eyodwa iphindaphindwa ngokuphuma kwenye, khona uma isethwa njengo-u, u-du uhambisana ngqo, ngakho ukufaka esikhundleni kuyasebenza.
l-m-h3-b0d07-30.s.s2.model.1: f'(x)dx kufanele ibe ngu-du ukuze isibalo siguquke sibe i-integral ka-u kuphela, ngakho umbandela ukuthi isimo sokuphuma sikhona nalo yini.

l-m-h3-b0d08-03.title: Ulwazi oludingekayo emkhawulweni we-(aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹)
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.goal: Ukuthola umkhawulo we-(aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹), nquma ukuthi yiziphi izinga (ulwazi) ezidingeka ngokuphelele, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani uzikhethile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.material: Ezinombolweni ezi-positive a no-b, ufuna ukunquma inani le-lim(n→∞) (aⁿ+bⁿ)/(aⁿ⁺¹+bⁿ⁺¹).
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi ulwazi oludingeka ngokuphelele ukunquma inani?
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.a: Noma ngo-a+b ofanayo, imikhawulo ye-(2,1) ne-(1.5,1.5) ihlukile.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi u-a no-b ziyizinombolo eziphelele yini
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.c: Noma zingeyona izinombolo eziphelele, inani lomkhawulo liyanqunywa.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.r.d: Uma u-a no-b bephozithivu, ukuthi u-n uyi-even noma i-odd akunandaba.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s1.explain: Umkhawulo ungu-1/max(a, b). Amandla alo omkhulu alawula i-numerator ne-denominator.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.0: Amandla enombolo enkulu alawula isamba, ngakho umkhawulo uba ngu-1/(inombolo enkulu), yingakho udinga ukwazi ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-03.s.s2.model.1: Uma a>b, khona-ke (b/a)ⁿ→0, ngakho umkhawulo ungu-1/a, futhi noma a=b ungu-1/a, ngakho ukwazi omkhulu kubo bobabili kunquma umkhawulo.

l-m-h3-b0d08-16.material: Ekhebula elinikezwe yi-parameter, x=f(t), y=g(t), ufuna ukuthola i-slope ye-tangent ku-t=1.

l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.r.c: Ngaphandle kokwazi u-dx/dt, awukwazi ukunquma i-slope.
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s1.explain: dy/dx=g'(t)/f'(t), ngakho ku-t=1 udinga womabili amanani, u-f'(1) no-g'(1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s2.model.0: I-slope ngu-dy/dx=g'(1)/f'(1), ngakho udinga ukwazi zombili izinga zokushintsha ze-x ne-y, u-f'(1) no-g'(1).
l-m-h3-b0d08-16.s.s2.model.1: Izindawo u-f(1) no-g(1) azingeni ku-slope, ngakho inombolo engaphezulu u-g'(1) nesihlukanisi u-f'(1) kuyadingeka ngempela.

l-m-h3-b0d09-11.goal: Linganisela umehluko ku-y phakathi kwe-hyperbola ne-asymptote yayo uma u-x emkhulu, nquma usayizi noma uhla olufanele, bese uchaza ukucabanga kwakho.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.material: Egatsheni lesokudla le-hyperbola u-x² − y² = 1, y≈9.95 uma u-x=10. Umehluko ku-y kusuka ku-asymptote u-y=x ungu-0.05 cishe. Linganisela umehluko uma u-x=100.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.prompt: Liyiphi ilinganiselo elifanele lomehluko uma u-x=100?

l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.c: Kufana nokuku-x=10, ngakho akubonisi ukuthambekela kokusondela.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.r.d: Leli nani lisusa ikhebula kude nesi-asymptote.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s1.explain: Umehluko ngu-x−√(x²−1)=1/(x+√(x²−1))≈1/(2x). Ku-x=100 ungu-0.005 cishe, uncipha ngokulinganayo ngokuphambene no-x.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.0: Ungu-0.05 ku-x=10, futhi uma u-x eba izikhathi ezingu-10, umehluko uncipha ube ngu-1/10, ngakho ungu-0.005 cishe.
l-m-h3-b0d09-11.s.s2.model.1: x−y=1/(x+y) futhi x+y≈200, ngakho umehluko ungu-1/200=0.005 cishe.

l-m-h3-b0c36-20.material: Imiphumela yokuhlolwa okungu-200: abantu abagulayo abangu-40 batholwe kahle njengo-positive, abagulayo abangu-10 bashiywe, abaphilile abangu-20 bagwetshwe ngephutha njengo-positive, nabaphilile abangu-130 batholwe kahle. l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s1.explain: Ingezansi ye-recall yinani langempela labantu abagulayo, 40+10=50. 40/50=80%, futhi 40+20 yinani lalabo abaqagelwe ukuthi bangu-positive, elisetshenziselwa i-precision.
l-m-h3-b0c36-20.s.s2.model.0: I-recall yingxenye etholakale phakathi kwabantu abagulayo bangempela, ngakho ingezansi kumele ibe ngu-40+10=50, kodwa kwengeziwe u-20 futhi lokho kuphutha; inani elilungile ngu-80%.

l-m-h3-b0c37-17.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo esibala i-cosine phakathi kwamavektha amabili, noma uchungechunge lwaso lwesizathu nomphumela, ngokulandelana, uthole indawo yokuqala lapho kuphutha khona, bese ulungisa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.material: Lesi yisixazululo somfundi esithola cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|) ku-a=(3,4) no-b=(4,−3). Thola umugqa wokuqala ophutha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.a: Umphumela we-dot product ubalwe kahle. Akuyona iphutha.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.r.d: Isihlukanisi siphutha, kodwa i-dot product ingu-0, ngakho inani liyafana. Kunomugqa ophutha wangaphambili.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s1.explain: |b|=√(4²+(−3)²)=√25=5. Isikwele siyipositive noma ngabe luyini uphawu, ngakho kufanele wengeze.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.0: Njengoba (−3)²=9, |b| ingu-√(16+9)=5, kodwa ku-③ u-9 wakhishwa futhi waba ngu-√7, ngakho ③ yiphutha lokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c37-17.s.s2.model.1: Ukwenza izikwele zamacandelo kuwenza wonke abe yipositive, ngakho kufanele wengeze, kodwa kwakhishwa, ngakho lungisa ③ ube ngu-5.

l-m-h3-b0c37-19.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo esihlukanisa isamba samaphutha ayizikwele ukuthola i-slope, noma uchungechunge lwaso lwesizathu nomphumela, ngokulandelana, uthole indawo yokuqala lapho kuphutha khona, bese ulungisa.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.material: Silinganisa umugqa y=wx namaphoyinti (1,2), (2,3), no-(3,7). Thola umugqa wokuqala ophutha esixazululweni esihlukanisa isamba samaphutha ayizikwele J(w)=(w−2)²+(2w−3)²+(3w−7)² ukuthola u-w onika inani elincane kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.r.a: Isamba samaphutha ayizikwele sisethwe kahle. Akuyona iphutha.

l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s1.explain: Ku-②, okuphuma ngaphakathi 2 no-3 kwa-(2w−3)² no-(3w−7)² kwashiywa. Isisho esilungile ngu-J'(w)=28w−58.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.0: Uma uhlukanisa umsebenzi oyinhlanganisela, ama-coefficient 2 no-3 esisho sangaphakathi ayaphindaphindwa, kodwa ashiywa ku-②, ngakho leso yiphutha lokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c37-19.s.s2.model.1: J'(w) elungile ngu-2(w−2)+4(2w−3)+6(3w−7)=28w−58, ngakho ②, okungaphindaphindanga nge-coefficient, yindawo ephutha.

l-m-h3-b0c46-19.title: Ubufakazi bokuthi 1=2: kwaphosa kuphi?
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.goal: Landela isinyathelo ngesinyathelo ukusebenza okuqala ku-a=b futhi kukhombisa ukuthi 2=1, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, ukuthola indawo yokuqala eyaphosa futhi ulungise.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.material: Ake u-a=b. ①a²=ab ②a²−b²=ab−b² ③(a+b)(a−b)=b(a−b) ④Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(a−b) ukuthola u-a+b=b ⑤Njengoba u-a=b, 2b=b, ngakho 2=1.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.a: Lesi yisibalo esilungile esenziwe ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.b: Lesi yisibalo esilungile esenziwe ngokukhipha u-b² ofanayo ezinhlangothini zombili.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.r.c: Lesi yisibalo esilungile esenziwe ngokuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngezici.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s1.explain: Uma u-a=b, bese u-a−b=0, ngakho ④ ihlukanisa ngo-0. Ukuhlukanisa ngo-0 akuchazwanga.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s2.model.0: Njengoba u-a=b, a−b=0, kodwa ku-④ izinhlangothi zombili zahlukaniswa ngo-0, ngakho kuyiphutha.
l-m-h3-b0c46-19.s.s2.model.1: Ukuhlukanisa ngo-0 kunika umphumela ongenakunqunywa, ngakho u-a+b=b ngemva kuka-④ akunaso isisekelo, futhi no-2=1 akuyiqiniso.

l-m-h3-b0c46-21.material: Ufaka u-1,000,000 won (100 emayunithini angu-10,000 won) ngenzalo yokuhlanganisa yonyaka engu-10% iminyaka engu-2. ①Ngemva konyaka o-1: 100×1.1=110 (×10,000 won) ②Inzalo yonyaka wesi-2 ngu-10% ka-100, okungu-10 (×10,000 won) ③Ngemva kweminyaka engu-2: 110+10=120 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Ukuthola inzalo yonyaka wesi-2 njengo-10 (×10,000 won)
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.r.c: Ukwengeza kuyiso, kodwa inzalo yatholwa kabi ngaphambilini.
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.o.d: ①~③ zonke ziyiso futhi umphumela kuphela oyiphutha
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.r.d: Uma ubheka isinyathelo ngasinye, kwase kuphosile ku-②.
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s1.explain: Ngenzalo yokuhlanganisa, inzalo nayo ithola inzalo. Inzalo yonyaka wesi-2 ngu-10% ka-110 (×10,000 won), okungu-11 (×10,000 won), ngakho isamba singu-121 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s2.model.0: Ngenzalo yokuhlanganisa, inzalo yengezwa kumali eyinhloko kanye nenzalo ngemva konyaka o-1, u-110 (×10,000 won), ngakho inzalo ku-② kufanele ibe ngu-11 (×10,000 won).
l-m-h3-b0c46-21.s.s2.model.1: Ukubala inzalo ku-100 (×10,000 won) kuphela kuyinzalo elula, ngakho inzalo yokuhlanganisa ingu-110×1.1=121 (×10,000 won).

l-m-h3-b0c47-18.title: Yiluphi ulayini lapho isixazululo se-Euclidean algorithm siqala ukungalungi khona?
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.goal: Landela isinyathelo ngesinyathelo isixazululo esithola isihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu sika-252 no-105 usebenzisa i-Euclidean algorithm, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, bese uthola futhi ulungise lapho siqala ukungalungi khona.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.material: Lesi yisixazululo esithola isihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu sika-252 no-105. ① 252 = 105×2 + 42 ② 105 = 42×3 + 21 ③ 42 = 21×2 + 0 ④ Isihlukanisi 21, ngaphambi kokuba insalela ibe ngu-0, siyisihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.o.d: ④ Isihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kakhulu singu-21
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s1.r.d: Isiphetho silungile. 252 no-105 kokubili kuyizinombolo eziphindwe ngo-21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.0: 42×3+21=147 akunikezi 105, ngakho ② yilapho kuqala ukungalungi khona. Kumele kulungiswe kube ngu-105 = 42×2 + 21.
l-m-h3-b0c47-18.s.s2.model.1: Ukuphindaphinda u-42 ngo-3 kunika u-126, ngakho insalela evela ku-105 ingabe ingu-21. 84, okungu-42 ophindaphindwe ngo-2, kanye no-21 kwenza u-105, ngakho ② kumele kulungiswe.

l-m-h3-b0c47-19.title: Ukwenza i-engeli elungile ngentambo enamafindo: isixazululo siphutha kuphi?
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.goal: Landela isinyathelo ngesinyathelo isixazululo esenza unxantathu one-engeli elungile ngentambo enamafindo, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, bese uthola futhi ulungise lapho siqala ukungalungi khona.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.material: Kunendlela yokwenza i-engeli elungile ngentambo ehlukaniswe ngezingxenye ezingu-12 ngamafindo. ① Yenza izinhlangothi ezintathu ngezingxenye ezingu-3, 4, no-5 ② 3+4+5=12, ngakho yonke intambo iyasetshenziswa ③ 3²+4²=25=5², ngakho unxantathu one-engeli elungile ④ I-engeli elungile yakheka phakathi kohlangothi olubude obungu-3 nohlangothi olubude obungu-5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.a: ① Izinhlangothi ezintathu zezingxenye ezingu-3, 4, no-5
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.a: Intambo enezingxenye ezingu-12 ingahlukaniswa ibe ngu-3, 4, no-5.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.r.b: 3+4+5=12, ngakho yenza ngqo indingilizi eyodwa yentambo.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.o.d: ④ I-engeli elungile iphakathi kwezinhlangothi 3 no-5
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s1.explain: I-engeli elungile iphambene nohlangothi olude kakhulu, u-5. Okungukuthi, yakheka phakathi kohlangothi olubude obungu-3 nohlangothi olubude obungu-4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s2.model.0: Kusukela ku-5²=3²+4², i-engeli elungile iphambene nohlangothi olude kakhulu, u-5, ngakho i-engeli elungile kumele yakheke phakathi kwezinhlangothi 3 no-4.
l-m-h3-b0c47-19.s.s2.model.1: I-engeli elungile iphakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili ezimfushane, ngakho ④ kumele kulungiswe kube phakathi kuka-3 no-4.

l-m-h3-b0c47-20.title: Ukuthola i-golden ratio: yiluphi ulayini oyiphutha lokuqala?
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.goal: Landela isinyathelo ngesinyathelo isixazululo esithola i-golden ratio, lapho uhlangothi olude luyizikhathi ezingu-1.618, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, bese uthola futhi ulungise lapho siqala ukungalungi khona.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.material: Uma isikwele esinde esinohlangothi olude x nohlangothi olufushane 1 sinegolden ratio, khona-ke x:1=(x+1):x. ① x² = x+1 ② x²−x−1=0 ③ x=(1±√5)/2 ④ Njengoba ubude buyinombolo ephozithivu, x=(1−√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.a: Esilinganisweni, umphumela wamaphuzu angaphakathi ulingana nomphumela wamaphuzu angaphandle, ngakho kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.b: Yi-equation x²=x+1 nakho konke kuhanjiselwe ohlangothini olulodwa, ngakho kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.r.c: Ukufaka a=1, b=−1, c=−1 ku-quadratic formula kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s1.explain: (1−√5)/2 ungu-−0.618 cishe, inombolo engeyona ephozithivu. Ubude buyinombolo ephozithivu, (1+√5)/2≈1.618.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.0: √5≈2.236, ngakho (1−√5)/2 ungu-−0.618 cishe, inombolo engeyona ephozithivu, futhi ayikwazi ukuba ubude. Lungisa kube ngu-(1+√5)/2.
l-m-h3-b0c47-20.s.s2.model.1: Ubude buyinombolo ephozithivu, ngakho kufanele ukhethe enkulu kuma-root amabili, (1+√5)/2≈1.618, kodwa ④ ikhethe i-root encane.

l-m-h3-b0c48-19.title: Liyini iphutha esixazululweni esithola u-2=1 kusukela ku-a=b?
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.goal: Landela izinyathelo zesixazululo esibonisa u-2=1, noma uchungechunge lwesizathu nomphumela, uthole lapho kuphutha khona okokuqala, bese ulungisa.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.material: Ake a=b bese uphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a ukuthola a²=ab. Khipha b² ezinhlangothini zombili ukuthola a²−b²=ab−b². Ukwenza izici kunika (a+b)(a−b)=b(a−b). Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(a−b) kunika a+b=b, okungukuthi, 2b=b, ngakho 2=1.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.a: Phindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a ukuthola a²=ab
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.a: Ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngenombolo efanayo kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.b: Khipha b² ezinhlangothini zombili ukuthola a²−b²=ab−b²
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.b: Ukukhipha inombolo efanayo ezinhlangothini zombili kulungile.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.o.c: Hlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(a−b) ukuthola a+b=b
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.r.d: Ukubala okufaka a=b kulungile. Inkinga isemugqeni wangaphambilini.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s1.explain: Uma a=b, khona-ke a−b=0, ngakho lokhu kuhlukanisa ngo-0. Ukuhlukanisa ngo-0 akuvunyelwe.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s2.model.0: Uma a=b, khona-ke a−b=0, ngakho ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(a−b) kusho ukuhlukanisa ngo-0, okuyiphutha.
l-m-h3-b0c48-19.s.s2.model.1: Ukuhlukanisa ngo-0 akunakwenzeka, ngakho isixazululo siphutha okokuqala kule ngxenye yokuhlukanisa, futhi u-2=1 olandelayo umphumela walelo phutha.

l-m-h3-b0d07-16.material: Ukuhlukanisa u-y=ln(x²+1): (1) Vumela u=x²+1, ngakho y=ln u (2) dy/du=1/u (3) du/dx=2x (4) y'=1/u+2x
l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s1.o.d: Ulayini (4): lapho lezi ezimbili zengezwa khona

l-m-h3-b0d07-16.s.s2.model.1: I-chain rule iyi-(1/u)×2x, ngakho akufanele uzengeze; ukuphindaphinda kunika 2x/(x²+1).

l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.a: Ulayini (1): lapho izinhlangothi zombili zahlukaniswa khona
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.b: Ulayini (2): lapho u-y' wahlanganiswa wanyakaziswa khona
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.o.c: Ulayini (3): lapho u-y' wabhalwa ngokuhlukanisa khona
l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s1.r.c: (3) ivela ekuhlukaniseni (2), ngakho akuyona indawo yokuqala eyiphutha.

l-m-h3-b0d07-23.s.s2.model.0: Ukuhambisa 2x+y uye ohlangothini lwesokudla ku-(1) kwenza uphawu lube ngu-−, ngakho (2) iyiphutha, futhi i-slope elungile ingu-−3/3=−1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-29.s.s2.model.0: Kusuka ku-du=2x dx, u-x dx ungu-du/2, hhayi u-du, ngakho (2) akulungile. Impendulo elungile ngu-(1/2)ln(x²+1)+C.

l-m-h3-b0d08-14.material: Ukwenza i-derivative ka-y=x/(x²+1): (1) f=x, g=x²+1, ngakho f'=1, g'=2x (2) y'=(f'g−fg')/g² (3) inombolo engaphezulu 1·(x²+1)−x·2x=x²+1−2x (4) y'=(x²−2x+1)/(x²+1)²

l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.o.c: Umugqa (3): lapho inombolo engaphezulu ibalwe khona

l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s1.explain: x·2x=2x², ngakho inombolo engaphezulu ngu-x²+1−2x²=1−x². Ngakho y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².
l-m-h3-b0d08-14.s.s2.model.0: x·2x ungu-2x², hhayi u-2x, ngakho umugqa (3) uphosile. Inombolo engaphezulu elungile ngu-1−x², futhi y'=(1−x²)/(x²+1)².

l-m-h3-b0c33-24.s.s2.model.0: Kusuka ku-5,000q=2,000,000+3,000q, ukuthutha u-3,000q uye ohlangothini lwesokunxele kunika (5,000−3,000)q=2,000,000.

l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.r.d: U-5% akulona usayizi womphumela; kuyisilinganiso sokwahlulela.
l-m-h3-b0c43-26.s.s1.explain: Kusho ukuthi uma sithatha ukuthi akukho mphumela, ukungenzeka kokuthola umphumela onje kungaphansi kuka-5%, ngakho kunzima ukucabanga ukuthi kungenxa yethuba.

l-m-h3-b0c47-23.material: I-golden ratio φ (cishe engu-1.618) iyanelisa φ = 1 + 1/φ. Thola enye i-equation esho into efanayo nale.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.prompt: Khetha i-equation esho into efanayo neyokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.b: Iyasebenza kuphela uma φ=2. Kodwa φ ingu-1.618 cishe.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.r.c: Uma ususa φ ezinhlangothini zombili, uthola 0=1, okungamanga.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s1.explain: Phindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-φ bese uthola φ² = φ + 1. Uma φ≈1.618, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-2.618 cishe.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.0: Ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ngo-φ kunika φ²=φ+1, ngakho isho into efanayo ne-equation yokuqala.
l-m-h3-b0c47-23.s.s2.model.1: Ukufaka φ=1.618 kunika φ²≈2.618 no-φ+1=2.618, ngakho zombili ama-equation anika inani elifanayo.

l-m-h3-b0d07-05.material: Isamba soqhungechunge u-Σaₙ kusukela egameni lokuqala kuya egameni lesi-n singu-Sₙ=n/(n+1). Veza uchungechunge olufanayo ngegama elivamile u-aₙ.

l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s1.explain: f'(x)=e^(−x)−x e^(−x)=(1−x)e^(−x) no-e^(−x)>0, ngakho f'>0 kusho 1−x>0, okungukuthi, x<1.
l-m-h3-b0d07-25.s.s2.model.0: Ngomthetho womkhiqizo f'(x)=(1−x)e^(−x), futhi u-e^(−x) uhlala eyi-positive, ngakho f'>0 kuyafana no-1−x>0, okungukuthi, x<1.

l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi i-integral emisiwe elingana nalo mkhawulo?
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.a: U-2/n ububanzi besikhawu, ngakho awuphindaphindi ngo-2 ngokwehlukile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.b: Inani elingaphakathi ku-f ngu-1+2k/n, ngakho u-x uhamba usuka ku-1 uye ku-3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.r.c: Ubude besikhawu bungu-(2/n)×n=2 futhi siqala ku-1, ngakho siphela ku-3.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s1.explain: U-2/n ububanzi, futhi x=1+2k/n uhamba usuka ku-1 uye ku-3. Ngakho kungu-∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.0: Ukuqoqa izingcezu ezingu-n zobubanzi obungu-2/n kunikeza ubude obungu-2, futhi x=1+2k/n uhamba usuka ku-1 uye ku-3, ngakho kungu-∫₁³ f(x)dx.
l-m-h3-b0d07-32.s.s2.model.1: Uma k=1, u-x mkhulu kancane kuno-1, futhi uma k=n, x=3, ngakho isikhawu singu-[1,3]. Yingakho silingana nale i-integral emisiwe.

l-m-h3-b0d09-06.material: Isethi yamaphoyinti u-P(x, y) asebangeni elilinganayo ne-focus u-F(0, 2) nomugqa oqondisayo u-y = −2 yi-parabola. Guqula lesi simo sibe yisibalo esisodwa.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.a: Ku-4py, p=2, ngakho kungu-8y, hhayi u-4y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.b: I-parabola inayo i-y-axis njenge-axis yayo, ngakho u-x no-y bashintshiwe.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.r.c: I-focus iphezulu, ngakho ivulekela phezulu. Uphawu luhlukile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s1.explain: Ukwenza isikwele izinhlangothi zombili ze-√(x²+(y−2)²)=|y+2| kunika u-x²+y²−4y+4=y²+4y+4, okungukuthi, x²=8y.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.0: Ukubhala "amabanga alingana" njengesibalo kunika u-x²+(y−2)²=(y+2)², futhi ukwenza lula kunika u-x²=8y, ngakho kusho into efanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-06.s.s2.model.1: Uma i-vertex iyimvelaphi futhi i-focus ngu-(0,2), bese p=2, ngakho x²=4py=8y, futhi njengoba ivulekela phezulu uphawu nalo luyiso.

l-m-h3-b0d09-24.title: Ukuchaza i-engeli elungile kanxantathu ngama-vector
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.goal: Guqula i-engeli elungile ku-vertex eyodwa kanxantathu ibe enye indlela (i-equation, ithebula, isithombe, noma amagama), futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani zisho into efanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.material: Bhala kabusha isitatimende sokuthi i-engeli ku-vertex u-A kanxantathu u-ABC iyi-engeli elungile njenge-equation ngama-vector. Bhala ama-vector ezinhlangothi ze-AB ne-AC.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.a: Le equation isho ukuthi i-engeli ku-vertex u-B iyi-engeli elungile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.b: Isho ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili zinobude obufanayo. Ayinaso isixhumana ne-engeli elungile.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.r.c: Uma isamba siyi-zero vector, ama-vector amabili abhekene nezinhlangothi eziphambene.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s1.explain: Uma izinhlangothi ezimbili ku-A ziyi-perpendicular, i-AB·AC=0. Uma i-dot product ingu-0, ama-vector amabili angeyona ama-zero vector ayi-perpendicular.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s2.model.0: Uma i-engeli ku-A iyi-engeli elungile, i-AB ne-AC ziyi-perpendicular, ngakho i-dot product ingu-AB·AC=|AB||AC|cos90°=0.
l-m-h3-b0d09-24.s.s2.model.1: I-AB·BC=0 isetshenziswa lapho i-engeli ku-B iyi-engeli elungile, ngakho ku-engeli ku-A, sebenzisa izinhlangothi ezimbili i-AB ne-AC ezisuka ku-A, okunika i-AB·AC=0.

l-m-h3-b0d09-38.goal: Guqula isibalo esikhulisiwe sendilinga sibe yifomu elinye (isibalo, ithebula, isithombe, noma amagama), bese uchaza ukuthi kungani zisho into efanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.material: Isibalo sendilinga sikhuliswe sibe x² + y² + z² − 2x + 4y − 6z + 5 = 0. Sibhale kabusha ngefomu lapho isikhungo nerediyasi kubonakala ngokushesha.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.b: Uhlangothi lwesokudla yisikwele sherediyasi, ngakho ngu-9, hhayi 3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.r.c: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwenziwe ngephutha ngokungeza inombolo engaguquki 5.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s1.explain: Ukuqedela izikwele kunika (x−1)²+(y+2)²+(z−3)²=1+4+9−5=9. Isikhungo ngu-(1, −2, 3) futhi irediyasi ngu-3.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.0: Ukuqedela isikwele sika-x, y, no-z ngakunye kwengeza 1+4+9 futhi kuhambisa 5, ngakho uhlangothi lwesokudla luba ngu-9, futhi kuyisibalo esifanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d09-38.s.s2.model.1: Ukuhambisa uhlangothi lwesokudla 9 kwesobunxele bese ukhulisa kunika −2x+4y−6z nenombolo engaguquki 1+4+9−9=5, ngakho kufana nesibalo sokuqala.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.b: Indlela A ikhetha u-Y futhi Indlela B ikhetha u-X, ngakho ziyahluka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.o.c: B: Hlukanisa ngosayizi uqhathanise isiqondiso kuphela

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.r.d: Usayizi awunaxhumana nokuthi ifanele kangakanani ukunambitheka.
l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s1.explain: U-X unesiqondiso esifanayo no-s, ngakho cos=1, futhi u-Y ungu-0.45 cishe. I-dot product ibeka u-Y, omkhulu ngosayizi, phezulu, ngakho ayifanelani nenhloso yesiqondiso.

l-m-h3-b0c37-25.s.s2.model.1: I-dot product iphume iphezulu ku-6 ngoba u-Y mkhulu, kodwa isiqondiso sakhe sihlukile, ngakho uma isiqondiso siyinhloso, B ifanelekile.

l-m-h3-b0c50-10.s.s1.o.d: Bobabili bayafana: inani lokugcina lingu-17 kokubili
l-m-h3-b0c50-10.s.s1.explain: U-B unika u-2, 5, 10, 17 ngqo. U-A unika u-7 no-12 ezinsukwini zesonto 2 no-3, ezingafaneli.
l-m-h3-b0c50-10.s.s2.model.0: U-B unika u-2, 5, 10, 17 ku-x=1 kuya ku-4, kodwa u-A unika u-7 esontweni 2, ngakho u-B ufanelana kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0c50-10.s.s2.model.1: U-A uyafana ekuqaleni nasekugcineni kuphela futhi iphutha maphakathi, ngakho khetha Imodeli B, evumelana nawo wonke amanani.

l-m-h3-b0c50-27.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi incazelo eyisisekelo esifanele kakhulu se-'odd + odd ngu-even'?

l-m-h3-b0c50-27.s.s1.r.b: Noma zithile, zisebenza kuphela ezibonelweni ezihloliwe.
l-m-h3-b0c50-27.s.s1.r.c: U-A uchaza ezinye izinombolo ezingu-odd futhi u-B uchaza zonke, ngakho ahlukile.

l-m-h3-b0c50-27.s.s2.model.1: U-A uyiqiniso emacaleni amathathu ahloliwe kuphela, ngakho ukusho ukuthi isamba sanoma yiziphi izinombolo ezingu-odd singu-even, u-B ufanelana kakhulu.

l-m-h3-b0d07-06.title: Umkhawulo we-√(n²+n)−n: isixazululo sikabani esilungile?
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezimbili noma izimangalo mayelana nomkhawulo we-√(n²+n)−n, khetha esifanelana kangcono, bese uchaza isizathu sakho.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.material: A: 'Njengoba i-√(n²+n) iseduze no-n, umehluko ungu-0.' B: 'I-rationalizing inika n/(√(n²+n)+n), ngakho umkhawulo ungu-1/2.' Qhathanisa izixazululo ezimbili.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi olunika ukuhlolwa okulungile kwezixazululo ezimbili?
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.o.a: A ulungile. Amagama amabili aba cishe alingana.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.r.a: Uma n=1000, umehluko ungu-0.4999 cishe, hhayi u-0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.o.b: B ulungile. Umehluko wamagama amabili aseduze awuhlali ungu-0.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.r.c: Iziphetho zihlukile, 0 no-1/2, ngakho akunakulunga kokubili.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.r.d: Umehluko usondela ku-1/2, ngakho umkhawulo uyakhona.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s1.explain: Uma n=1000, √(n²+n)−n ingu-0.4999 cishe. I-rationalizing inika 1/(√(1+1/n)+1)→1/2.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s2.model.0: Amagama womabili akhula abe makhulu, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi umehluko ungu-0, futhi i-rationalizing inika 1/(√(1+1/n)+1)→1/2, ngakho B ulungile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-06.s.s2.model.1: Uma n=1000 inani lingu-0.4999 cishe, ngakho akulona u-0 futhi lisondela ku-1/2, okwenza isixazululo sika-B silunge.

l-m-h3-b0d07-19.title: I-derivative ye-sin²x: kungani imiphumela emibili ihlukile?
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.goal: Qhathanisa izindlela ezimbili noma izitatimende mayelana ne-derivative ye-sin²x, khetha esihambisana kangcono, futhi uchaze ukucabanga kwakho.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.material: Lapho kuhlukaniswa i-sin²x, u-A wathola 2sin x cos x, futhi u-B wayibhala kabusha njengo-(1−cos 2x)/2 ngaphambi kokuhlukanisa wathola u-sin 2x. Imiphumela emibili ibonakala ihlukile.

l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.r.a: Indlela ka-B nayo ilungile, futhi umphumela uyi-function efanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.r.b: Umphumela ka-A nawo uyi-function efanayo ne-sin 2x.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.o.c: Bobabili baphutha. Izinkulumo zihlukile komunye nomunye.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.r.c: Noma ifomu lihlukile, ziyinkulumo efanayo nge-double-angle formula.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.o.d: Bobabili balungile. 2sin x cos x = sin 2x
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s1.explain: Nge-double-angle formula 2sin x cos x = sin 2x, imiphumela emibili iyi-function efanayo.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s2.model.0: Kukhona i-double-angle formula 2sin x cos x = sin 2x, ngakho ama-derivative amabili ayi-function efanayo futhi bobabili balungile.
l-m-h3-b0d07-19.s.s2.model.1: U-A wasebenzisa i-chain rule futhi u-B wasebenzisa i-half-angle formula, kodwa imiphumela ifana kuwo wonke u-x, ngakho bobabili balungile noma izindlela zihlukile.

l-m-h3-b0d07-36.goal: Esikhathini sokugcwalisa ithangi lamanzi, pima zonke izimo eziphikisanayo, khetha ukuvumelana okungcono kakhulu, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.material: Amanzi ageleza engxenyeni ngo-(12−2t) amalitha ngomzuzu ngesikhathi t semizuzu (0≤t≤6). Kumele igcwaliswe okungenani ngamalitha angu-33 kodwa akumele idlule umthamo wayo wamalitha angu-36, futhi isikhathi esifushane siyangcono.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.prompt: Phakathi kwezinketho, yisiphi isikhathi esingcono kakhulu esihlangabezana nezimo?
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.r.d: Ngamalitha angu-36 futhi ihlangabezana nezimo, kodwa ithatha isikhathi eside kuneminzuzu engu-5.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s1.explain: Inani elingena ngemizuzu engu-T lingu-12T−T². Phakathi kwezinketho, isikhathi esifushane kakhulu esifinyelela okungenani ku-33 siyimizuzu engu-5 (amalitha angu-35).
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s2.model.0: Ngemizuzu engu-T, amalitha angu-12T−T² ayangena; ngemizuzu engu-5 kungamalitha angu-35, okungu-33 okungenani, futhi imizuzu engu-4 inika amalitha angu-32, angaphansi.
l-m-h3-b0d07-36.s.s2.model.1: Imizuzu engu-5 neminzuzu engu-6 kokubili kufinyelela okungenani amalitha angu-33 ngaphandle kokudlula angu-36, kodwa isikhathi esifushane siyangcono, ngakho imizuzu engu-5 ihambisana kangcono kakhulu.

l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s1.explain: Uma indawo ngu-150 no-y≤15, x≥10. Ubude 2x+150/x buyanda ku-x≥8.7, ngakho x=10 (35 m) kufushane kakhulu.
l-m-h3-b0d08-21.s.s2.model.0: Ngoba y≤15 no-xy=150, x≥10, futhi ubude 2x+150/x buyanda ku-x>8.66, ngakho x=10 inikeza ubude obufushane kakhulu, 35 m.
